text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hmmmm... What to choose... What to
choose...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I can't decide between Falco or
Vodka.
choice_data_list: Can't decide on the lunch menu?
Can't decide on the lunch menu?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Why are you looking at me like that? They
ordered different things off the
menu, so I can't
decide which of the two
I should get.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Being able to eat the same exact meals
as my oshis every day is a luxury only
afforded when attending this sacred
institution, Tracen
Academy!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Yesterday, I had Ryan's
lunch, and Tamamo's the day before
that! Oh, but don't
worry! I'm making
sure to keep my diet balanced!
choice_data_list: Could it be... every single day...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
If it's a day I choose Spe or Oguri, I'm
always
careful to get a more manageable
portion.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Eating the same lunch as my oshis is an
official
method to infinitely expand
one's imagination.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I want to intervene, but that'll just drag
the
conversation on longer, so I keep
quiet and hand
her a lunch tray.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oohoohoo... You wanna geek out
together over
lunch? ♪ I know, why
don't you choose for me?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whose lunch do you think looks better?
Falco's or
Vodka's?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Falco's lunch! She likes her plates to
look
photogenic!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
All right, Falco always eats her salad
first, so I'll
be following sui—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Digital! Is it okay if I sit next to
you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Fwah! Falco?! Um? Uhhh, we can just
move,
actually!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Nooo, that's not what I want! I'm asking if we can eat together.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehehehe, thanks! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, just as I thought! You got the same
thing I
did! I caught a glimpse of your
tray, and it made
me curious.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Agyaaaa! I'm sooo sorry for copying you!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Is that your way of showing respect? I'm
really
flattered! ☆ Ooh, I wanna take a
selfie!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
A fan told me earlier that she wants to
attend Tracen Academy, so I thought
it'd be nice if I posted some pics to show
her what campus life is
like.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
You're doing this for your fan? O-ohhh!
You're
such a model Umadol! Sublime...
to the max!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So, can I post a pic of you and your
lunch on
Umatter too?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Pwah?! A picture with m-m-m-me?! I
mean, if it's for one of your fans, then I
guess it'll be in service
to a comrade,
but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, then let's take one together! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ooh, this one looks good!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if she'll see my post. You know,
she told
me she's good at running on dirt
too.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's why I wanted to respond to her
letter by showing off some training
methods. So, how do
you usually train,
Digital?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I don't know if this will be of any use or not, but... I try to run on the dirt practice course when it's firm and when it's heavy.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So you do special training on tracks with
bad
footing! It's hard to keep good form
in those
conditions, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Not only that, I get a lot of people to
run with me... It helps me practice
dealing with dirt and
sand flying at me
from up ahead.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, I see what you mean! I'm a front
runner so I
don't usually have to deal
with that.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You've really got your dirt training in
order!
Hmmm, I'd better watch my back.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Nononono! You're still in a whole
different league
than me!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Don't think you can trick me into letting
my guard
down! ☆ I've marked you as
my rival now.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ggk... Ghk... Nghhh! I-I'm... not...
wooorthy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, Agnes Digital and Smart
Falcon spend
a fruitful lunchtime talking
about how they
practice for dirt races.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Okay! Let's dig in with Vodka's lunch!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Hey! What's the big idea, sitting next to
me?!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"It's not like I'm sitting next to you
because I want
to. This is the only seat
that's free. That's all."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
You totally got it! You really are a simp
after my
own heart!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I get so immersed imagining Vodka's

conversations while enjoying the same
food she
eats!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Fwhoa! Vodka just stole one of Scarlet's
shrimp...
"Excuse you! You think it's okay
to just snatch
other people's food?!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, Agnes Digital spends the
entire lunch period imagining a dialogue
between Vodka and
Daiwa Scarlet... like
a true superfan.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wooo! I'm stuffed! That's what I call a
fulfilling
lunch!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Digital, do you have a second?
There's
something I'd like to check with
you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Were you mimicking us back in the
cafeteria?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Eeek! I'm s-s-s-soo sorry! I'll make it up
to you!
I'll... I'll harakiri!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Harakiri?! Why?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Cause you're scarin' the crap outta her.
Look at
how she's shakin'...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... A real-life quarrel between Scarlet and Vodka, right in front of me... Guehehe.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
This ain't a fight!
I'm just callin' her out
for puttin'
you on the spot, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...It's not like I'm angry or anything.
I just thought
it was incredible you could hear
us from that distance. Your hearing must
be amazing.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I was just imagining what I thought
you might
be saying... I couldn't hear
your conversation at
all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You were just imagining it?! But you
were dead on for the whole
conversation! Are you sure you
weren't
lipreading or something?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
N-no, it was really just my imagination.
Um, by
the way... how come you guys
noticed what I was
doing?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Like anyone couldn't notice, you were
practically
shoutin' at your trainer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry! I don't deserve to live!
choice_data_list: You were so absorbed you didn't ev...
You were so engrossed you didn't e...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You gotta say sorry each time? It isn't
that deep!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, you really recreated our whole

conversation just by imagining it? That's
pretty
damn amazin'.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...I think it just goes to show how
thoroughly she's
researched us.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
In that case, lemme do some research of
my own! Come run with me, Digital! Best
way to grasp your
opponent is to duke it
out with 'em!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hey, that's no fair! You can't hog her! I
want to
run with Digital too!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What? Quit tryna butt in!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
A match against me would help Digital
get
serious. ...Oh, but I see. You're
scared I'm going
to beat you, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
As if! That's totally my line! Fine, all
three of us
can run!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A-all three of us? I've got VIP seats to a
battle
between Scarlet and Vodka?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: WOOHOOOOOAGHKJ!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital is walking on sunshine...
and the group running session after
school turns out to be
a very fruitful
practice.
